messages:
alex: Heads-up — planning a quiet-window swap of the quant kernel bundle tomorrow 02:00 UTC. Low-risk but includes a micro matmul change that bumped a perf micro-diff in internal tests. Posting planned steps and rollback criteria.

maria: thanks. what's the exact bundle id and changelist? need to draft the release notes snippet.

alex: bundle: quant-bundle-v2.3.4
alex: changelist:
```
- matmul: f16 accumulation fix (perf + stability)
- quantizer: packing v2 (opt for small models)
- no kernel ABI bump; no config schema changes
```

sam: can we do a staged rollout? 1% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% with 15m steady windows?

alex: yep. plan: 1% canary (30m), 10% (15m), 50% (30m), 100% (ramp 1h). rollback if p95 latency +5% over baseline OR error-rate delta >0.2% absolute. also abort on any core OOMs.

jamie: i'll take release notes. can someone paste perf numbers vs current in staging and blamelist for the change?

alex: staging perf (median of 5 runs): baseline p95=120ms, candidate p95=124ms (+3.3%). hist tail looks stable. blamelist: @maria (quant packing), @sam (matmul microopt PR #8421)

maria: checksum for bundle is `sha256:6b9f3c1d2e8a4f9b7a9d...` (short). cc @jamie

deploybot: scheduled deploy job created: job=rb-202303-173777 bundle=quant-bundle-v2.3.4 target=prod-quiet-window-02:00UTC canary=1% steps=[1,10,50,100]

alex: pin command if we need to hold rollback:
```
deployctl pin --bundle quant-bundle-v2.3.4 --reason "hold after canary" --ttl 4h
```

ops-bot: night-oncall (ops-night) notified for 02:00 UTC window — @ops-night please ack

sam: running a quick staging microbench now, will post numbers in 10m

deploybot: staging preflight smoke ✅ (connectivity, kv-cache health, basic prompts). logs: https://deploylogs.internal/rb-202303-173777

jamie: drafting notes now, will include changelist + perf table + rollback criteria. aiming to push to the relnotes doc in ~30m: https://redwood-internal/relnotes/173777

maria: i'll watch telemetry (p95, cpu, gpu mem alloc) during canary and call abort if tail spikes.

alex: thanks all — I'll run the canary and update here with each step. :thumbsup:
